waterbodyGroup: Seven Lakes of San Pablo City
purpose: Run bounded coordinate-bearing GBIF searches for Actinopterygii in crosswalked lake polygons and the unmatched Mohicap OSM polygon.

screens.geometrySource: HydroLAKES Asia subset polygons with OSM spatial crosswalks documented in calabarzon-seven-lakes-osm-hydrolakes-crosswalk-20261030.json and calabarzon-sampaloc-osm-hydrolakes-crosswalk-20261030.json.
OpenStreetMap community-mapped lake outline, relation/feature crosswalk context in calabarzon-seven-lakes-osm-hydrolakes-crosswalk-20261030.json.

rejectedRequest.geometry: Exact OSM multipolygon of all seven lakes
rejectedRequest.interpretation: GBIF rejected the oversized request; this is not a zero-result query and no occurrence outcome was inferred. Shorter HydroLAKES candidate polygons and a separate Mohicap OSM polygon were queried instead.

limitations: These are bounded, coordinate-bearing GBIF occurrence searches and not fish surveys, lake checklists, or exhaustive searches of uncoordinated and differently georeferenced records.

The six matched HydroLAKES shapes are discovery candidates with mapped-source crosswalks, not official or field-validated lake boundaries; Mohicap uses community-mapped OSM geometry because no HydroLAKES polygon intersected in the screen.
Zero rows do not demonstrate fish absence, current ecological condition, fishing access, or legal catchability.
No records, names, taxonomic claims, diet statements, or public app rows were added.
nextAction: Shift from further zero-result polygon searches to independently reusable or rights-cleared Seven Lakes fish survey/checklist sources; review species, locality, survey dates, taxonomy, and reuse terms row by row before admission.
